facts.fact: The Council of Ministers of 13 January 2026 examined the 2026 budget of the Agence Djiboutienne des Normes et de la Qualite (ADN) at 134.9 million FDJ, up from 112.1 million in 2025, and stated that in 2025 the ADN made two technical standardisation committees operational, for agri-food products and for electrical and household-appliance products; no IT or data standard is mentioned.
